caption: After every run of five 1s the sender inserts a zero, so the 15 input bits become 17 bits on the wire; the highlighted zeros are the inserted bits, and the receiver deletes them to recover the original 15 bits.

spec.title: Bit stuffing on the example frame
spec.aria: An array showing the 15 input bits, then the 17 stuffed bits in two parts, with the two inserted zeros marked and labelled as inserted.
